purpose: New CORE hypotheses, not a repeat of the rejected 144 threshold configurations

families.fundamental: Conditional finish probabilities from relative pre-race abilities, exhibition and weather; no market features in the learner
families.residual: Conditional market log-probability offset plus learned corrections from abilities, lane-one weakness and market concentration
families.place: Keep market first-place marginal fixed; learn corrections only to conditional second and third place probabilities

earlyStopping: 2023-08-01..2023-08-31; conditional log loss only, never ROI
annualValidation: 2024-01-01..2024-12-31; previously explored development year, not pristine holdout
nextValidation: Only after a 2024 candidate passes, freeze one model and policy by SHA256 and evaluate pre-Q4 2025. No automatic Q4 opening or LONGSHOT work.
candidateRanking: Among annual passers: highest ROI without largest hit, then number of purchases, then model ID
limitations: 2023 training/validation is not an independent annual replication
Historical odds capture time is unverified; archive is not proof of live five-minutes-before-close performance
2024 cache conditions on six-boat settled races; excluded-race execution/cancellation behavior remains unvalidated
